images.title: The painted school wall
images.purpose: Set up the question 10/27 − 1/27: a wall of 27 equal panels with 10 painted and 1 washed by rain, for the student to take away and then simplify fully.
images.composition: One wide flat wall of panels across the upper middle with space around it, and two short text lines centred below.
images.exact_structure: One flat rectangular wall made of exactly 27 equal square panels in 3 rows of 9, outlined in dark grey. Painted panels, filled teal #0072B2: the first 5 panels of the top row and the first 5 panels of the middle row, 10 in all. The first panel of the middle row also has a thick reddish purple #CC79A7 dashed outline to mark it as washed by rain. All other 17 panels are plain. No rain cloud, no people. Below, centred: two short text lines. Exactly 27 panels, 10 teal, 1 purple outline.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
any result of the subtraction or its simplest form shown in numbers, or panels grouped into boxes
images.takeaway: Take away panels, then simplify all the way.
images.description: A wall of 27 equal panels in 3 rows of 9, with 10 panels painted teal and 1 painted panel outlined as washed by rain; the question asks for 10/27 − 1/27 in lowest terms, with no answer shown.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to count the teal panels without the washed one and then look for a way to group all 27 panels.

image_decisions.why: A countable wall of equal panels sets up the take away and the simplifying without revealing the result.
